body: Hi, The internet keeps cutting out at night and then comes back. The light on the fibre box stays green but pages stop loading. It started since last Monday. This is completely unacceptable.
resolution_steps: Check the ONT/fibre terminal for a red LOS light and note the optical power level in the line diagnostics.
Check for congestion on the customer's GPON port and node during 19:00-23:00.
Move the customer to a less loaded port or raise a network capacity ticket if utilisation is above 85%.
Replace the patch cable and re-seat the fibre connector if optical power is outside -8 to -27 dBm.
Call back after 48 hours to confirm the drops have stopped.

Create an incident ticket and give the customer the reference number and ETA.

Ask the customer to confirm the light pattern on the ONT (power, PON, LOS) and the fibre cable seating.
Run a remote line test and check whether the ONT is registered on the OLT.
If the ONT is offline with LOS, book a field technician visit within 24 hours.
Offer a temporary mobile hotspot data pack while the repair is pending.
Create an incident ticket and give the customer the reference number and ETA.

body: Hi, I can't move my eSIM to my new phone. It says the profile cannot be added. I tried switching it off and on several times. It has been like this for days. This is completely unacceptable. Account number 4455667788.
resolution_steps: Verify the customer identity and confirm that the new device supports eSIM.
Cancel the old eSIM profile and generate a new activation QR code or code string.
Ask the customer to connect to Wi-Fi and scan the new QR code on the new handset.
Check that the profile status changes to active in the provisioning system.
Re-issue a new code if installation still fails, since each QR code works only once.

Cancel the old eSIM profile and generate a new activation QR code or code string.
Ask the customer to connect to Wi-Fi and scan the new QR code on the new handset.
Check that the profile status changes to active in the provisioning system.
Re-issue a new code if installation still fails, since each QR code works only once.
